newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks close soft, investors mark time.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks close soft, investors mark time.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks closed marginally lower on Tuesday as investors waited for direction, brokers said.
The all share index closed 2.41 points down at 726.75. Price declines outnumbered gains by 40 to 22. Development Finance fell 5.25 rupees to 265 and Lanka Ceramic one to 38.

"Investors, mainly big ones, are waiting to see if the index will fall a little more," said Aslem Ahmed of CDIC Sasoon Cumberbatch Stock Brokers. "If one big investor is seen buying, others will follow."
Colombo shares, which fell more than 13 points on profit-taking last week, have been flat since Friday as investors remained on the sidelines to see if the market had bottomed out, brokers said.
Turnover was 35.9 million rupees, led by 146,700 Bogala Graphite, 158,700 Ceylon Holiday Resorts and 132,100 Kegalle Plantations.
